topic.source_contract: local transport plan BSIP enhanced partnership franchising funding service delivery

scope_guards: An LTP policy is not treated as a funded site-specific transport scheme.
A BSIP proposal is not treated as an operating bus service.
An Enhanced Partnership plan is not treated as delivery of every listed measure.
A funding allocation is not treated as procurement, construction or sustained operation.
A timetable aspiration is not treated as a registered and operating service.
Bus franchising powers are not treated as an adopted franchising scheme.
A nearby route is not treated as suitable site access or capacity.
No score or promotion is written without exact stop, route, frequency, access, funding, legal arrangement, delivery and operation evidence.
